inline_text:
JSON-first taxonomy review for the working group.
## Files
- `CURRENT-WORKSTREAMS.md` — workstreams and pull-request practice
- `taxonomy-landscape/README.md` — section index, outline, contributor paths, source-document lookup
- `taxonomy-landscape/CONTRIBUTING.md` — JSON field semantics, Taxonomy WG schema alignment, ARWG `x-*` review fields
**JSON slices** — pattern: `taxonomy-landscape/s{section}-{topic}-{p0|p1|p2}.json`  
(one file per D1 section × priority band; example: `s08-failure-p0.json`)
| Slug prefix | Topic |
|-------------|--------|
| `s03-boundaries-*` | System boundaries and evaluation subjects |
| `s04-core-*` | Accuracy, reliability, and output quality |
| `s05-reliability-dimensions-*` | Reliability dimensions |
| `s06-governance-*` | Operational and governance terms |
| `s07-grounding-*` | Grounding, evidence, and world |
| `s08-failure-*` | Failure vocabulary (symptoms and root causes) |
| `s09-metrics-*` | Metrics and measurement |
| `s10-ecosystem-*` | Evaluation ecosystem |
| `s11-response-*` | Response — design and correction (preliminary) |
